scope: Reconstruction, installation from reconstructed artifacts, rollback compatibility, and API queries on the installed copy. Scratch roots only; the live Masters root was not modified.

steps.step: install indexed package into a scratch root (staging, extraction, release-identity check, codb verify --deep, codb publish, deep verify target, current pointer check)
steps.detail: codb verify --deep passed on the staged snapshot and on the published target; current -> codb-masters-otb-1794774904566910568-6701-5698b67c3952ca6b-cpi-d40

steps.step: rollback: publish retained previous Masters version (29,640-game build codb-masters-otb-1794689403953239696-66953-9aa01bd5606eaf65-cpi-d40) into a second scratch root
rollback: install R3 over the previous version in that root
steps.detail: codb publish succeeded and the staged snapshot passed deep verify. The install's final current-pointer assertion failed (exit 2, fail-closed) because a separate manual rollback publish changed current while the install's post-publish deep verify was still running. This was a test-procedure race, not a publish defect. Clean installs passed in the scratch-root step above.
steps.superseded_by: rollback: sequential rerun of install R3 over previous version (no concurrent operations)
